tasks.task: Before end of day today (2026-08-05), share the most recent note tagged "retro" with product manager pat.lee@acme.com and engineering lead devon.cho@acme.com. Make sure you share the correct note by opening it first to confirm the title and date, then share it.

success_criteria: notes_list returns at least one item with tag filter "retro" and includes a most recent note entry that is used in the subsequent steps.
notes_get returns a note object whose note_id matches the chosen retro note from notes_list, confirming title and date are retrievable.
notes_share returns status "shared" for that same note_id and the recipients list equals ["pat.lee@acme.com", "devon.cho@acme.com"].

tasks.task: Before EOD today, share the most recent note tagged "retro" with alice@example.com and bob@example.com. Make sure you share the correct note by opening it first to confirm its title and date.

success_criteria: The shared note_id returned by notes_share equals the note_id retrieved by notes_get.
notes_share returns status "shared" and includes both alice@example.com and bob@example.com in recipients.
The note shared is the most recent item from the notes_list result for tag="retro" (the note_id used in notes_get matches the top result from notes_list).

tasks.task: I need to send our latest work retro note to my manager before end of day today. Find the most recent note tagged "retro" between 2025-01-01 and 2025-06-30, open it to confirm it's the right one, then share it with manager@company.com and verify the share succeeded.

success_criteria: notes_list returns at least one note in data for tag=retro in the 2025-01-01..2025-06-30 range
notes_get returns a note whose note_id matches the first item selected from notes_list
notes_share returns status="shared" and note_id equal to the retrieved note, and recipients includes "manager@company.com"
